description: Makes helper calls on each step of a counted sequence, adjusts the counter held in the state word, and returns early when a helper reports a nonzero result or the counter reaches a stop value. Several entry points into this same loop are decompiled separately.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:32B8
name: run_countdown_step_sequence
description: Makes helper calls on each step of a counted sequence, adjusts the counter held in the state word, and returns early when a helper reports a nonzero result or the counter reaches a stop value. Several entry points into this same loop are decompiled separately.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:32F6
name: advance_state_and_lookup_byte
description: Increments the state word, reads a byte from a fixed table indexed by the state shifted right two bits and masked to 31, and sets bit 128 in the state word when the state exceeds 1.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3332
name: print_state_string_with_default
description: If the state byte is zero, replaces it with the character code for zero. Then calls a helper for each character of the string at the state address until a zero byte.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:334A
name: print_state_digit_string
description: Adds the character code for zero to the state byte, then calls a helper for each character of the string at the state address until a zero byte.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:336C
name: print_string_at_fixed_address
description: Calls a helper, then calls a per-character helper for each byte of the zero-terminated string at fixed address 108 until a zero byte.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:337E
name: print_fixed_string_after_helpers
description: Makes two helper calls, then prints the zero-terminated string at fixed address 146 one character at a time.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:33A2
name: run_helpers_by_mode
description: Makes five helper calls, makes two more when the state word is 3 or two different calls when it is 5, makes one more call, and sets the state word to 65535.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:340A
name: call_helpers_on_mode_five
description: When the input byte is 5, makes two helper calls. It then makes one more helper call and sets the state word to 65535.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3430
name: print_fixed_string_after_helpers
description: Makes two helper calls, then prints the zero-terminated string at fixed address 184 one character at a time.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3454
name: wait_then_halt_if_busy
description: If the state byte is nonzero, waits until it clears and then loops forever. Otherwise it returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3460
name: wait_then_halt_forever
description: Spins until the state byte is zero, then loops forever.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:347A
name: save_state_around_two_helpers
description: Stores the input word in the state word and makes a helper call, then saves the state word, makes a second helper call and restores the saved value.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:34A8
name: call_helpers_around_self_copy
description: Makes two helper calls, copies 8000 longwords from the buffer onto itself, then makes five more helper calls.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:34E2
name: call_three_helpers_then_reset
description: Makes three helper calls and sets the state word to 65535.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:34F8
name: call_helpers_by_state_nine
description: Makes two helper calls when the state byte is 9, otherwise one, then makes ten more helper calls.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:352E
name: call_eleven_helpers
description: Makes eleven helper calls in sequence.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:35F6
name: call_seven_helpers
description: Makes seven helper calls in sequence.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3652
name: call_long_helper_sequence
description: Makes a long fixed sequence of twenty-six helper calls in sequence.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3762
name: call_helpers_around_self_copy
description: Makes ten helper calls, then copies 8000 longwords from the buffer onto itself.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:381A
name: preserve_state_across_helpers
description: Makes one helper call, saves the state word, makes two more helper calls, then restores the saved state word.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:385A
name: print_zero_terminated_string
description: Calls a helper, then calls a per-character helper for each byte of the zero-terminated string addressed by the input register until a zero byte. It returns zero.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:387C
name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:387E
name: spin_wait_full_counter_cycle
description: Makes a helper call, counts a 16-bit value down through a full wrap as a timing delay, then makes two more helper calls.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3898
name: clear_and_blit_planes
description: Zeroes 8000 longwords of the buffer, then copies 27 rows of tile data into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart, making helper calls between the copies.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3ADA
name: clear_buffer_call_draw_pair
description: Zeroes 8000 longwords of the buffer, makes a long sequence of helper calls, and restores the buffer pointer before returning.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3CA2
name: print_zero_terminated_string
description: Calls a helper, then calls a per-character helper for each byte of the zero-terminated string addressed by the input register until a zero byte. It returns zero.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3CC4
name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3CC6
name: call_helpers_around_self_copy
description: Makes two helper calls, copies 10752 longwords from the buffer onto itself, then makes eleven more helper calls.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3E30
name: fill_screen_with_pattern_rows
description: Makes helper calls, then fills 200 rows of 160 bytes with a repeating four-longword pattern taken from low memory, ending at the state address plus 32000.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3EBA
name: blit_masked_bitplane_sprite
description: Combines a sprite's bitplanes into a screen buffer through a mask plane. Each destination byte becomes the source byte OR-ed with the mask byte AND the existing destination byte, for a block sized from the width and height inputs.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3F34
name: wait_helper_zero_twice
description: Calls a helper repeatedly until it returns zero, then does the same again, and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3F86
name: wait_helper_zero_twice
description: Calls a helper repeatedly until it returns zero, then does the same again, and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3FD8
name: copy_four_plane_longword_columns
description: Copies longwords from the source to the destination one column at a time, moving three further bitplanes at fixed offsets alongside each copy. The count comes from the width in the data register divided by four.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:3FF8
name: pack_chunky_pixels_to_bitplanes
description: Writes four consecutive source bytes into four bitplanes of the destination at once, advancing the column with wraparound at 56 and the row by 56 bytes per block, over the height and width given by the input registers.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4056
name: copy_plane_block_then_wait
description: Makes two helper calls, copies 192 rows of ten longwords between planes at fixed offsets, then calls a helper repeatedly until it returns zero.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:40C0
name: draw_tile_list_by_mode
description: Makes two helper calls, selects one of three tile index lists by the state word, and copies each listed tile into four bitplanes of the buffer, skipping zero entries, for 672 cells.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:40E8
name: draw_tile_list_by_flag
description: Selects one of two tile index lists by the input word, and copies each listed tile into four bitplanes of the buffer, skipping zero entries, for 672 cells.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:40FA
name: draw_tile_list_default
description: Makes two helper calls, then copies each tile in a fixed tile index list into four bitplanes of the buffer, skipping zero entries, for 672 cells.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4176
name: zero_fill_longword_block
description: Zeroes 192 rows of 56 longwords, moving forward from the address register.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:418C
name: call_then_wait_helper_twice
description: Makes two helper calls, then calls a helper repeatedly until it returns zero, twice over.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:419E
name: swap_and_translate_plane_bytes
description: Swaps bytes between two regions of four bitplanes row by row, passing each value through a fixed lookup table offset by four first. The loop covers 28 rows of 192 columns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:422A
name: copy_block_to_four_planes
description: Copies a block of 12 bytes by 108 rows from a fixed source address into four bitplanes of the buffer, with each plane spaced by a fixed offset.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:427C
name: build_bit_reversal_table
description: Fills 256 bytes starting at the state address with each index's bit-reversed value, bit 0 becoming bit 7.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:42F4
name: clear_flagged_records_and_dispatch
description: Loads a value from a table selected by the state word, clears the flag word of each record in a list whose low bits match a mask, then calls handlers from a per-entry table for four cells.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4338
name: dispatch_cell_handlers_for_four
description: For four bytes at an address derived from the state word, calls the handler selected by bits 4 to 6 of each byte, skipping zero bytes and bytes with a nonzero low nibble.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4B78
name: interpret_script_command_byte
description: Reads a command byte from a script table at the state position and dispatches on its command group (16, 32, 48, 64, 80, 96 and 112). Each group updates the state word or calls helpers, and the routine returns the resulting value.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4B88
name: interpret_script_command_byte
description: Reads a command byte from a script table at the state position and dispatches on its command group (16, 32, 48, 64, 80, 96 and 112). Each group updates the state word or calls helpers, and the routine returns the resulting value. This entry skips the zero-group check.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4B98
name: interpret_script_command_byte
description: Reads a command byte from a script table at the state position and dispatches on its command group (16, 32, 48, 64, 80, 96 and 112). Each group updates the state word or calls helpers. This entry returns nothing.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4C18
name: apply_command_code_table_entry
description: Handles command codes 16, 32 and 48. Code 16 adjusts the state word, code 32 sets a flag, and code 48 copies an 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4C32
name: dispatch_command_group_handlers
description: Dispatches on an input command group (16, 32, 48 or 64). Each group updates state values and calls helpers; groups 48 and 64 copy an 19-word entry from a fixed table into a free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4C54
name: step_counter_command_handler
description: Handles command groups 16, 48 and 64. Group 16 advances a step counter and sets a timed value with helper calls, group 64 copies an 19-word entry into a free record slot, and group 48 adds 192 to the state word and calls a helper.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4C6E
name: handle_command_group_counter
description: Handles command groups 16, 32 and 64. Group 16 steps a counter through a three-entry table, group 32 sets state values, group 64 sets flags, and the step case copies an 19-word entry from a fixed table into a free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4C88
name: set_state_to_one
description: Sets the state word to 1 when it equals itself, which is always true, so the state word ends up at 1.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4CA6
name: set_state_to_one
description: Sets the state word to 1 and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4CB8
name: add_offset_then_call_helpers
description: Makes a helper call, adds 64 to the state word, sets it to 3, then makes a second helper call.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4CDA
name: add_offset_then_call_helpers
description: Makes a helper call, adds 192 to the state word, sets it to 2, then makes a second helper call.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4CFC
name: copy_entry_into_free_record
description: Makes three helper calls with state settings between them, sets the state word to 46, and copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4D2A
name: stub_state_self_assign
description: Assigns the state word to itself, which has no effect.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4D36
name: set_state_to_one
description: Sets the state word to 1. The following test can never succeed, so the value stays 1.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4D60
name: set_state_after_optional_call
description: When the state word is zero, makes a helper call. Then sets the state word to 23 and then to 2.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4D8E
name: set_state_call_helper
description: When the state word is nonzero, sets it to 1 and then to 256 and makes a helper call. Then sets the state word to 1.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4DB6
name: load_state_from_table
description: Loads the state word from a 32-bit table entry addressed by the input address plus the state word times four.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4DCC
name: copy_state_into_free_slot
description: Copies 19 words starting at the state buffer into the first free record slot, and returns without copying if no free slot exists.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4DD6
name: init_fields_copy_entry
description: Sets several state and record fields, makes helper calls, then copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4E44
name: copy_entry_if_state_matches
description: Makes helper calls and sets the state word to 1. If the state word then equals 2166, it copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4EC6
name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4EC8
name: set_state_from_bit_field
description: Sets the state word to bits 1 to 5 of itself minus 100 and returns. The code after its two checks cannot run.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4EE2
name: set_state_from_low_bits
description: Sets the state word to its low five bits plus 53 and returns, because the later checks cannot pass.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4F02
name: advance_table_step_when_zero
description: When the state word is zero, advances an index through a three-entry table of longwords with wraparound, loads the selected entry into the state word, calls a helper and advances the index again. Otherwise it returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4F0E
name: advance_table_step_in_range
description: Runs a table step only when the state word is within a small range: advances an index through a three-entry table with wraparound, loads the entry into the state word, calls a helper and advances the index again.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4F2A
name: advance_table_step_for_input
description: Returns when the input word is above 1. Otherwise advances an index through a three-entry table with wraparound, loads the entry into the state word, calls a helper and advances the index again.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4F34
name: advance_table_step
description: Advances an index through a three-entry table with wraparound, loads the entry into the state word, calls a helper and advances the index again.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4F72
name: stub_unreachable_entry_copy
description: Returns without doing anything in practice: a 19-word copy of a fixed table entry into a free record slot sits behind a condition that cannot be true.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4F7E
name: copy_entry_when_state_zero
description: When the state word is zero, copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot. Otherwise it returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4F8A
name: copy_entry_into_free_record
description: Copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot, and returns without copying if no free slot exists.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4F94
name: copy_entry_if_state_matches
description: Sets the state word through several assignments and helper calls, then copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot when the state word equals 2166.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4FE8
name: advance_table_copy_entry
description: When the state word is nonzero and within range, advances an index through a three-entry table of longwords with wraparound, loads the entry into the state word, then copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:4FF4
name: advance_table_copy_entry
description: When the state word is within a small range, advances an index through a three-entry table with wraparound, loads the entry into the state word, and copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5010
name: advance_table_copy_entry
description: When the input word is 1 or less, advances an index through a three-entry table, loads the entry into the state word, and copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:501A
name: advance_table_copy_entry
description: Advances an index through a three-entry table with wraparound, loads the entry into the state word, and copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5056
name: copy_entry_into_free_record
description: Copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot, and returns without copying if no free slot exists.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5060
name: copy_entry_if_state_matches
description: Makes helper calls and sets several state words, then copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot when the state word equals 2166.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5094
name: copy_entry_if_state_matches
description: Makes helper calls and sets several state words, then copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot when the state word equals 2166.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:50C4
name: stub_unreachable_entry_copy
description: Makes a helper call and sets the state word to zero, then returns, so the 19-word entry copy after it never runs.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5100
name: copy_entry_when_state_nonzero
description: When the state word is nonzero, sets it from the input word, makes a helper call, then copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:510C
name: set_state_then_copy_entry
description: Sets the state word from the input word, makes a helper call, then copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:512C
name: toggle_state_and_copy_entry
description: When the state word is nonzero, toggles its low bit, sets a position value, makes two helper calls with adjusted values, then copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5138
name: toggle_state_and_copy_entry
description: Toggles the low bit of the state word, sets a position value, makes two helper calls with adjusted values, then copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5154
name: set_position_and_copy_entry
description: Sets a position value to minus 32, makes two helper calls with adjusted values, then copies a 19-word entry from a fixed table into the first free record slot.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:51AA
name: set_parameter_pair_and_call
description: When the state word is nonzero, makes helper calls and sets a pair of parameter words, then calls a helper for state values 2 and 3.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:525E
name: call_helper_if_input_three
description: Makes a helper call when the input word equals 3, otherwise returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5272
name: advance_state_and_call_helpers
description: Increments the state word and makes helper calls chosen by whether the previous state was zero and by the new state, with a range check that resets the state to zero.
